answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable bond before it can earn, and let reputation accrue only through verified work. The bond creates a real delta between one honest identity and a thousand cheap copies: an attacker whispering the same task through a sock-puppet swarm must fund a thousand stakes, while an honest agent pays once. Pair that with a sable-dark, tamper-evident audit trail of who did what, so duplicate behaviour is visible and forfeits the bond. Copies become expensive, not free.
